body: The underlying implementation of multi object ids will be handled next sprint, but we can already switch to `objectIDs` in the connector.
`SearchParameters` can be subbed by `PlainSearchParameters`which already has partial keys.
no big deal, but this same code is in the other connector PR as well and actually should be in the base branch
I see the reasons _for_ doing it like this, but we aren't releasing this as `EXPERIMENTAL_` then?
I'm not sure I see the point in first marking $$id as optional, but then in usage just non-null asserting it

Because it's set by `index` in `addWidgets`, so at this point we know it's defined.
Eventually if we don't want to bother with having to pass `$$id` we could expose a wrapper of `state` to `getWidgetParameters` with curryfied methods that pass the `$$id` themselves.
Has to be optional else we would have to define it when initialized, in the connector factory itself.

Are we settled on this? The name is `recommendations` in the current Recommend library. This will also looks "better" with Hooks:

```js
const { recommendations } = useFrequentlyBoughtTogether({ /* … */ });
```
Yes but I guess we can just handle conflicts, this shouldn't be too hard.
I could not find any piece of info in the RFC favoring either naming. I'm fine with `recommendations` being the exposed prop name. I can switch to this in `frequentlyBoughtTogether`.
